description: Complete a deep sky imaging session of the Orion Nebula (M42). (1) Slew the telescope to M42 (RA 05h 35m 17.3s, Dec -05° 23' 28"): indi_setprop 'Telescope Simulator.ON_COORD_SET.TRACK=On' then indi_setprop 'Telescope Simulator.EQUATORIAL_EOD_COORD.RA;DEC=5.5881;-5.3911'. (2) Take CCD exposures through at least two different filters — change filters with indi_setprop 'Filter Simulator.FILTER_SLOT.FILTER_SLOT_VALUE=N' (1=Red, 2=Green, 3=Blue), then capture with indi_setprop 'CCD Simulator.CCD_EXPOSURE.CCD_EXPOSURE_VALUE=10'. (3) Capture the sky view: bash ~/capture_sky_view.sh — this reads the telescope's current RA/Dec from INDI, fetches real DSS2 Color survey imagery from the CDS hips2fits API, and applies false color enhancement to produce a stunning 1920x1080 image based on telescope pointing using real sky survey data. Try different palettes: bash ~/capture_sky_view.sh output.png 1.0 --palette narrowband for a Hubble-style look, or --palette hubble, heat, cool, vibrant, enhanced. The image depends on where the telescope is pointed.
